caption:
Elephant Ears Recipe

desserts from A-Z, the goal : to try to make desserts i have never made before and we are on E for Elephant Ears or popularly known as Palmiers! 
This amazing dessert takes only 2 ingredients and can be ready within 30 minutes from start to finish 

Ingredients: 
-1 sheet puff pastry, thawed in the fridge overnight is best, I took mine out to room temperature 40 minutes before 
-1/2 cup caster sugar 

Method:
-sprinkle a little flour and take out your puff pastry sheet
-roll it out slightly to thin it a little
-sprinkle with caster sugar and fold as shown in the video 
-if your pastry is getting soft, place in the freezer for 10 mins to firm up
-slice and place on a baking tray lined with parchment 
-bake in a preheated oven (200 C) for 5-8 minutes each side ensuring you flip it 
-serve fresh or store in an air tight container at room temp
